# Stargate App — Cross-Chain Bridge on LayerZero Reference

> Stargate is a cross-chain bridge built on LayerZero that moves stablecoins and assets between chains from a single, unified pool of liquidity, non-custodially.

## Key Facts
- Protocol: Stargate — a cross-chain liquidity transport bridge built on the LayerZero messaging layer
- Action: bridging moves an asset between chains (changes the chain, not the asset)
- Delivery: native asset in, native asset out via unified liquidity pools (e.g. USDC on Ethereum -> USDC on Arbitrum)
- Chains: many EVM chains — Ethereum, Arbitrum, Optimism, Polygon, BNB Chain, Avalanche, Base and more
- Costs: source gas + protocol/LayerZero messaging fee + destination gas; large/imbalanced transfers can add slippage
- Custody: non-custodial — your wallet signs each step
